boundaries: Ordinary MP endpoints are checked before optional battle. Long Throw, Pokemon Switch and Goal Block check after atomic plate movement and before TurnEnd, matching their original output-effect checkpoints. Other displacement and marker transitions remain unimplemented.
Simultaneous victims use one occupancy snapshot and ascending figure index for Center entry; original ordering is unobserved.
Sleep/freeze/melt cannot-use clauses are interpreted as excluding surround contribution; original engine predicate is unobserved. Wait does not prevent contribution.
Optional Slippery swap, Ultra Beast immunity, evolution and replacement destinations fail closed when this check encounters them.
General special-marker storage, coexistence, suppression, curse exclusion and marker-triggered checks remain unimplemented.
